marginalia.note: Præfectus Vltrajectinus Gro-ninga, & munus aut potestas eius.

page.notes: The marginal note is set in short lines split across the margin ("Præfectus", "Vltraiecti", "nus Gro-", "ninga, &", "munus aut", "potestas", "eius."); I have joined them as one note. Its first word reads "Vltraiecti" in the margin, which I have written as Vltrajectinus to match the text; the margin's spelling is not fully clear. The "IV" after Henrico is set in small capitals and read as IV. The reading "succincta" is slightly uncertain from the scan.
